messages:
sasha: heads upthe morpheus13b int4 canary defaults change looks stable w.r.t OOMs but our nightly evals show ~6% hit to synthQA accuracy on long-turn prompts. failing traces attached.

jamie: ouch. which eval suite? long-turn synthQA from conv-suite-v3? was that included in the smoke job added earlier?

sasha: yes conv-suite-v3, the new longtrace set. failure concentrated on prompts with >800 generated tokens. short traces unaffected.

rafi: hypothesis: quantization + smaller batch sizing may alter beam/penalty timing, leading to tokenization boundary differences. Also prefetch eviction interplay could change cache priming, which affects long decoding patterns.

anita: can we repro deterministically? run A/B: baseline (master int8) vs canary (int4 defaults) on the 50 failing prompts and collect token-level diffs + perplexity.

sasha: ran A/B. diffs are concentrated in token selection around long repeats and list enumerations. perplexity delta small (+0.8) but top-1 token accuracy drops ~6% on those spots.

jamie: config snapshot for canary:
```
quant: int4
batch_size: 8
max_new_tokens: 1024
kv_reserve: 0.20
prefetch: true
runtime.flags: enable_async_compact=true
``` 

rafi: quick mitigation options:
- bump max_new_tokens back to 1536 for longer traces only (route by token_estimate)
- increase batch_size for long-turn requests to 12 if latency budget allows
- introduce per-model quality threshold: if token-accuracy on eval subset drops >3% -> route to int8 variant
- try quant-params tweak (recalibrate scale/zero points) for morpheus quant table

anita: I can run a targeted quant-recal job overnight and run the 50 toxic prompts. also try batch_size 12 run with same kv_reserve.

sasha: please also run a kernel-variant test: optimized-attn v2 vs fallback-attn v1. earlier we saw v1 has slightly different decode timing but sometimes better determinism.

ci-bot: scheduled jobs: morpheus-int4-quant-recal-overnight, morpheus-int4-batch12-longtrace-smoke, morpheus-kernel-variant-a_b. thresholds: 0 OOMs, token-acc delta <= 3%.

jamie: FYI ops: prefer not to rollback defaults if quality can be tweaked per-route. but we should have a fast rollback if nightly eval still flags >5% regressions.

ops-bot: added alert: morpheus-int4-quality-drop to oncall channel if nightly job fails threshold.

rafi: plan of attack:
1) run quant-recal overnight (anita)
2) run batch12 experiment and kernel A/B (sasha + anita)
3) if experiments don't recover, enable per-model routing to int8 for long-trace requests and reduce prefetch aggressive waves by setting kv_reserve 0.25 for long_turns
4) open eng-runtime ticket to investigate tiny decoder nondeterminism under int4 kernels

sasha: sounds good. I've uploaded diffs and a small analysis doc: https://internal/docs/morpheus-int4-qa-diffs. will report back tomorrow with results.

jamie: thanks. holding canary traffic at 5% until we have green from the targeted runs. closing for now but will reopen if jobs fail. :eyes:
